{{Article header|deck=A large Faulcon DeLacy multirole ship with an SCO-optimised Frame Shift Drive, broad Mk II module support, and substantial cargo capacity.}}

{{Ship infobox}}

The '''Anaconda Mk II''' is a large [[Ships|starship]] manufactured by Faulcon DeLacy. It is a modern multirole successor to the Anaconda, intended to remain credible in trading, mining, combat, and exploration without replacing a dedicated specialist in any one role.<ref name="frontierOctoberDevLog">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/elite-dangerous-october-dev-log-2026-law-disorder Elite Dangerous: October Dev Log 2026 — Law & Disorder], Frontier Developments, 14 October 2026.</ref><ref name="frontierGalnetLaunch">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/galnet/faulcon-delacy-announces-anaconda-mk-ii Faulcon DeLacy Announces Anaconda Mk II], GalNet, Frontier Developments, 20 October 3312.</ref>

The ship entered Live in update 4.4.2.0 on '''20 October 2026''' and is currently available through ARX Early Access.<ref name="frontierUpdate4420">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-2-0 Elite Dangerous: Anaconda Mk II Update], Frontier Developments, 20 October 2026.</ref><ref name="frontierEarlyAccess">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/anaconda-mk-ii-available-now-arx-early-access Anaconda Mk II — Available Now Via ARX Early Access], Frontier Developments, 20 October 2026.</ref>

{{Important|The Anaconda Mk II is live, but it has not yet entered general shipyard sale for credits. Frontier has not announced the wider-release date or credit price.}}

== Mk II module compatibility ==

The hull supports several modules and mounting options introduced for the current generation of ships:<ref name="frontierOctoberDevLog" /><ref name="frontierUpdate4420" />

* '''[[Armour|Mk II Ablative Armour]]''' can be fitted to strengthen the ship's defences.
* The cargo-restricted Size 6 optional internal can carry a '''[[Cargo Rack|Mk II Optimised Cargo Rack]]'''.
* Two hardpoints support the '''Mk II Mining Optimised''' mounting used with the '''[[Mining Laser|Mk II Mining Volley Repeater]]'''.
* The Size 8 [[Frame Shift Drive]] is SCO-optimised for native Supercruise Overcharge operation.<ref name="frontierGalnetLaunch" />

These options support the ship's general-purpose design rather than committing the hull to a single activity.

== Design and boarding area ==

The Mk II uses a redesigned hull with improved cockpit visibility. Its broad rear body, flattened silhouette, raised cockpit, upper-hull trench, and divided nose retain recognisable Anaconda features while giving the ship a distinct profile.<ref name="frontierSeptemberDevLog">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/september-2026-dev-log-law-disorder-first-details-anaconda-mk-ii-revealed September 2026 Dev Log: Law & Disorder First Details & Anaconda Mk II Revealed], Frontier Developments, 24 September 2026.</ref><ref name="frontierEarlyAccess" />

The Buur Pit's 16 October partner preview showed a wide boarding ramp opening into an enclosed lobby-like entry area, including a window looking out from inside the vessel. A door then transitions to the bridge through a fade.<ref name="buurPreview" /> Frontier's store also lists Cargo, Expedition, and Biological internal kit packs for this area.<ref name="frontierStore" />

{{Important|The partner preview demonstrates a limited boarding and entry area on the Anaconda Mk II. It does not establish unrestricted walkable ship interiors elsewhere in the vessel or across ''Elite Dangerous''.}}

== Field trials ==

Four Faulcon DeLacy initiatives are active from '''22 October to 29 October 2026''', covering exploration, mining, trade, and combat. Commanders may use '''any ship'''; owning or flying an Anaconda Mk II is not required.<ref name="frontierFieldTrials">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/galnet/faulcon-delacy-plans-anaconda-mk-ii-field-trials Faulcon DeLacy Plans Anaconda Mk II Field Trials], GalNet, Frontier Developments, 22 October 3312.</ref><ref name="frontierCommunityGoals">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/community/goals Community Goals], Frontier Developments. Accessed 22 October 2026.</ref>

! Register at
! Contribution

Recording at least one contribution in an individual initiative awards a Faulcon DeLacy decal, the Anaconda Mk II Faulcon Red paint job, and credits based on the initiative's success tier and the Commander's contribution. Recording at least one contribution in '''all four''' initiatives also awards a golden Faulcon DeLacy decal.<ref name="frontierCommunityGoals" />
